gameplayDistinctness: Visible shape/color set matching amid size distractors, arithmetic counting and real-time stopping of an automatic counter. Existing Bloom Tap uses nine-cell whack-a-mole and matching pairs; no shared rules or reskin.
reviewedGameSource: All 218 lines reviewed before syntax checking. Pixel sprite literals, pure random layout generation and vector distances, type/color matching, drawing, input, one-point scoring and sound/end calls only.
networkAndExecution: Original main has no imports, network IO, DOM access, storage, timer, dynamic evaluation or install hook. Only shared local scripts are loaded by index; CSP connect-src none and default-src none. The new observer forwards original calls unchanged and only copies state/events. No external font, image, audio or telemetry.
assets: All nine original programmatic sprites and original procedural BGM/SFX retained; original Playgarden SVG is only catalog art.
runtime: Existing audited local crisp-game-lib 1.0.2 and sounds-some-sounds lifecycle integration reused without engine/audio edits
optionalModes: Default simple theme; no Pixi, GIF capture, rewind, minifier or replay enabled

timing.counterStep: Subtract current original difficulty every active frame; increment when countdown becomes negative, unless input or an already-too-large count submits first
timing.reveal: nextTurnTicks increments each reveal frame; nextTurnTicks > 90 advances the turn or ends
timing.retry: Original gameOver accepts a new press when ticks > 20
timing.titleReturn: Without replay, original gameOver returns to title at ticks === 300

sourceChainCaveat: The archived 111-game README links the original repository, but does not list COUNT itself; the direct fixed source blob is the game-specific evidence.
sourceAndLicenseVerification: New main and MIT license Git blob SHA-1, SHA-256, length and runtime/vendor identity pass; all 55 records in the existing shared/second/cardq manifests reverified. Full shared MIT permission texts and component attribution are retained.
syntax: PASS node --check for original main, observer, TypeScript config and E2E spec (Node 24 strips types for syntax only; this is not a TypeScript typecheck)
dataAndAssets: PASS all package JSON parses, SVG XML parse and Python checker syntax
testing: Only source/static checks performed here. One focused desktop/mobile E2E is authored with physical input, one disclosed pre-load random stream, observed drawn shapes and original counter timing; no gameplay-state injection or clock acceleration.

browserE2E: NOT_RUN: one final e2e/count-observe.spec.ts invocation belongs to integrated CI
